title: Notifications
emptyDescription: When something happens with your tables or applications, you will see it here.

RegistrationRejected.title: Your application to {{tableName}} was turned down

ScheduleConflict.title: Your time at {{tableName}} clashes with another table
ScheduleConflict.message: It overlaps with {{otherTableName}}. You can withdraw an application or talk it over with the master.

SessionScheduled.title: The calendar for {{tableName}} changed
SessionScheduled.message: Check the session dates in your own time.

SessionCanceled.title: A session of {{tableName}} was cancelled
SessionCanceled.message: The table adds another one at the end, so it still plays the same number.
